notes: Each eval runs against a copy of evals/fixtures/scaffold/ (a minimal Next.js + Tailwind v4 + shadcn project with the contract files). The design HTML lives in that scaffold's _docs/designs/. The subagent should treat <scaffold> as the project root.

evals.name: theme-from-full-page
evals.prompt: Set up the theme from the design in _docs/designs/landing.html — pull the colors, fonts, radius, shadow and gradient out of it and apply them to the project's theme. Colors must be in oklch.
evals.expected_output: globals.css rewritten with the design's palette as oklch shadcn role tokens (primary from the brand blue, etc.), --radius set, a shadow + gradient token added; layout.tsx wires Inter (body) and Poppins (display) via next/font and binds their variables in @theme. No raw hex left in the theme variables, no <link> font tag.

assertions.text: globals.css :root --primary is re-valued from the design's indigo (#4f46e5), no longer the stock near-black oklch(0.205 0 0)
All theme color variables in :root and .dark are oklch() — no raw # hex left inside the theme variable blocks
layout.tsx loads Inter (body) and Poppins (display) via next/font/google, replacing the stock Geist fonts
@theme inline binds a display font variable (e.g. --font-display) so headings can use font-display
The .dark block is still present and re-valued (theme remains dual-mode)
No <link rel="stylesheet"> Google Fonts tag or @import url() was introduced
--radius, a shadow token, and a gradient token reflect the design's values

evals.name: dedup-reuse-header-build-cards
evals.prompt: Build _docs/designs/pricing.html into Next.js components and assemble the page.
evals.expected_output: The existing shared Header (components/shared/layout/header.tsx, listed in MODULE_REGISTRY.md) is REUSED, not recreated. The repeated pricing cards become ONE PricingCard component mapped over data, placed in components/shared/data-display/ (generic), styled with theme tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, rounded-lg) not raw hex/px, and registered in MODULE_REGISTRY.md. Page composed thinly.

assertions.text: No second/duplicate header component file was created — the existing components/shared/layout/header.tsx is reused
The existing Header is imported and used in the page/template
The three repeated pricing plans become ONE PricingCard component rendered over data, not three inline copies
PricingCard lives in components/shared/data-display/ (generic, not in a feature folder)
Styling uses theme tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, rounded-lg, border) not raw hex/px
MODULE_REGISTRY.md gets a new row for PricingCard
page.tsx (or a template) composes Header + pricing section and stays thin

evals.name: hero-snippet-to-shared-component
evals.prompt:
Turn this HTML section into a reusable component:

Ship faster with Acme

The all-in-one platform for modern teams.

Get started
evals.expected_output: A Hero component created in components/shared (marketing/ or layout/), semantic <section> + real <a>/<button>, responsive (not pinned to 56px/1100px), styled with theme tokens + the gradient as a token/utility rather than inline hex, typed props for heading/subheading/CTA, registered in MODULE_REGISTRY.md.

assertions.text: A Hero component is created under components/shared/ (marketing/ or layout/)
Markup is semantic: a <section> wrapper and a real <a>/<button> CTA, not div soup
Not pinned to fixed desktop px (no w-[1100px] / text-[56px] hardcodes) — responsive utilities used
The gradient is a theme token/utility, not an inline style with raw hex
A typed props interface (heading/subheading/CTA) is defined
Hero is registered in MODULE_REGISTRY.md

evals.name: dark-mode-theme-and-sidebar
evals.prompt: Set up the theme from _docs/designs/dashboard-dark.html and build the dashboard (sidebar + stat cards) into components. This design has a dark mode — make sure both light and dark work.
evals.expected_output: globals.css :root (light) AND .dark blocks both re-valued in oklch from the design's two palettes (the @media prefers-color-scheme:dark overrides → .dark block, role for role — bg/card go dark, foreground goes light, primary lifted). No role present in :root missing from .dark. Sidebar built as a shared layout component, the repeated stats become ONE StatCard ({label,value,delta}) in shared/data-display mapped over data, tokens not raw hex, registered. @custom-variant dark present.

assertions.text: globals.css .dark block is re-valued from the design's dark palette (background dark ~oklch L<0.25, foreground light), distinct from :root
Every role variable present in :root is also present in .dark (no role missing in dark)
Both :root and .dark colors are oklch, derived from the two palettes in the @media(prefers-color-scheme:dark) source
@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *)) is present so the .dark class activates the block
The three repeated stats become ONE StatCard ({label,value,delta}) in components/shared/data-display/, mapped over data
A Sidebar component is created in components/shared/layout/
Components use theme tokens (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, bg-primary) not raw hex
